summary: Hume is sunsetting TTS and EVI: access ends November 13, 2026 at 12:01 a.m. EST, with both APIs fully supported until then. This is a service shutdown, not a signup campaign deadline; account data is permanently deleted after November 13. Voice API billing docs still state that new accounts start on the free tier with $20 in credits. The pricing URL now redirects to the Hume homepage; the previously listed 10,000 monthly TTS characters and 5 EVI minutes could not be reverified. The TTS FAQ limits Free and Starter tiers to non-commercial use. Confirm new-account availability and allowances in the billing portal before relying on the grant.
